final: WITH customer_spending AS (SELECT c.CustomerId, COALESCE(SUM(i.Total), 0) AS amount_spent FROM Customer AS c LEFT JOIN Invoice AS i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId), customer_shares AS (SELECT amount_spent, 1.0 * amount_spent / SUM(amount_spent) OVER () AS share FROM customer_spending), shares_with_average AS (SELECT amount_spent, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM customer_shares) SELECT AVG(amount_spent) AS average_amount_spent, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM shares_with_average WHERE share > average_share
